name: Maschiff
description: Maschiff, the Rascal Pokémon. Able to evolve into Mabosstiff. A Dark type.
pokedex_entries: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.
Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
